item.title: Undertone 1.23.0
item.description:
• Comments on shared recaps. Discuss a recap with your team right under it. Type @ to mention someone; they're notified.
  • Assign action items. Give any action item to someone on the recap, and tick it off when it's done.
  • Team notifications. Mentions, replies and assignments show on the Team page, as a count in the sidebar and as Mac notifications. Mentions and assignments can also be emailed (turn this off in Settings › Team).
  • Artifacts, redesigned. Canvases now share one calm look, with where each came from shown under the title.

Undertone 1.22.0

  • Share recaps. Share a meeting's recap with your workspace or through a view-only link (7 days, 30 days or until you stop), with or without the transcript. Hints, coaching and your own tasks are never shared.
  • Team page in the sidebar lists the recaps your team has shared.
  • A shared recap updates when you rewrite it, and Stop Sharing turns its link off right away.

Undertone 1.21.0

  • Teams. A new Settings › Team tab: create a workspace, invite people by email, make admins, and let everyone at your company domain join or ask to join. Invites are accepted in Undertone by whoever signs in with that email.
  • Nothing from your meetings is shared yet: sharing recaps with your workspace comes next. Team features are free during the beta.

Undertone 1.20.0

  • Undertone account. Settings › Account: sign in with your email (no password) and your credits and Pro come with you to every Mac. Signing in on a second Mac no longer signs the first one out, and you can see and sign out the Macs you use.
  • Pro follows your account. Sign in with your purchase email and Pro turns on by itself; no key to paste.
  • Add your name: it's what teammates will see when team features arrive.

Undertone 1.19.0

  • Sync across your Macs (Pro). Turn on Settings › Data › Sync with iCloud and your meetings, memory, tasks, people and chats stay the same on every Mac signed in to your iCloud. Setting up a new Mac offers to bring everything over.
  • Your AI key, sign-ins and settings stay on each Mac. Files deleted on another Mac are kept for 30 days before they're removed.

Undertone 1.18.17

Undertone learns from each day

  • Every evening (or the next time you open it), Undertone looks back over the day's work meetings, Ask chats and ratings.
  • It remembers new facts (who owns what, decisions, deadlines) and drops ones that are now out of date.
  • It corrects term meanings it got wrong or too generic, and looks up terms that are still unclear in your sources.
  • It stops hinting terms you clearly know, and keeps a few lessons that shape tomorrow's hints, answer cards and Ask answers.
  • See what it learned on Home under "What Undertone learned", or press "Review now". Turn it off in Settings › "Learn from each day".
